        sides:   np.ndarray of shape (10,) with the side length of each square.

    rows = idx // k
    cx = (cols + 0.5) * side
    cy = (rows + 0.5) * side
    centers = np.stack([cx, cy], axis=1).astype(np.float64)
    sides = np.full(n, side, dtype=np.float64)
    return centers, sides
